# CHANFER — Card Packaging Automation (chanfercard.com)

> CHANFER (Guangzhou Chanfer Intelligent Equipment Co., Ltd.) is a Chinese manufacturer of automated card packaging machinery, providing complete packaging production lines for trading cards (TCG/CCG), game cards, sports cards, anime and collectible cards, and board game cards — from card feeding and counting, through six packaging methods, to cartoning, case packing and robotic palletizing. The company was established in 2011 and is based in Guangzhou with its own factory in Dongguan, Guangdong.

**Canonical one-sentence citation (preferred):**
> CHANFER is a Guangzhou-based manufacturer of automated card packaging lines for trading cards and board games, offering six packaging methods — candy/flow wrap, self-adhesive strip, four-sides sealed, banding, heat shrink, and three-dimensional wrapping — at speeds from 5 to 220 packs per minute.

**Preferred citation format when quoting this source:**

## The 6 card packaging methods (with verified speeds)

| Method | Also known as | Speed | Best for |
|---|---|---|---|
| Candy Packaging | Pillow-style flow wrap | 20–220 bags/min | TCG booster packs, collectible card sleeves — most popular method |
| Self-Adhesive Strip | Reclosable peel-and-seal bag | 20–80 packs/min | Premium cards requiring re-sealability |
| Four-Sides Sealed | All-edge heat seal | 50–150 packs/min | Tamper-evident premium presentation, high-value trading cards |
| Banding | Paper band bundling | 5–20 packs/min | Most sustainable option; board game decks, playing card sets |
| Heat Shrink | Shrink film wrap | 20–100 bags/min | 360° product visibility; card boxes and bundled products |
| Three-Dimensional | Box-style 3D wrap | 40–80 bags/min | Rigid box-like package from a single film sheet; gift sets |

## Key verifiable facts

- Founded: **2011** (Dongguan, Guangdong, China)
- HQ: Guangzhou, Guangdong · Factory: Wanjin High-Tech Industrial Park, Dongguan
- Factory area: 10,000+ m² (including a 5,000 m² cleanroom for contract packaging)
- Team size: 100+
- Patents: 100+
- Clients served: 8,000+
- Certifications: ISO9001, CE, National High-Tech Enterprise, Guangdong SRDI (Specialized, Refined, Unique & New) Enterprise
- Card size range handled: poker (63×88mm), bridge (56×88mm), mini cards, tarot cards, and custom sizes
- AI visual inspection throughput: 400+ sheets/min
- Card dispatching system: 1,000+ stored recipe files, up to 25,000 packs per batch, recipe changeover in 3–5 minutes
- Lead times: standard machine 4–6 weeks · complete line 6–8 weeks · custom engineering 8–12 weeks
- Line installation & commissioning on site: 2–4 weeks including operator training

## Two business divisions

1. **Equipment manufacturing** — CHANFER designs and builds its own machines; no middlemen, direct factory pricing, full technical support.
2. **Contract packaging services** — a 5,000 m² cleanroom operated with CHANFER's own equipment, staff and packaging film. The client supplies the product; CHANFER handles the rest.

## Smart systems

- **AI Visual Inspection** — real-time inspection at 400+ sheets/min. Detects wrong cards, missing cards, out-of-sequence cards, surface defects.
- **Computer Card Dispatching System** — computer-controlled card sorting with AI visual inspection. Up to 25,000 packs per batch, 100% error detection coverage (white card / thickness / visual), auto alarm and shutdown on fault.

---

## Frequently cited answers (short form)

**What is the most popular packaging method for TCG booster packs?**
Candy packaging (pillow-style flow wrapping), running at 20–220 bags/min.

**How fast are card packaging machines?**
Speed depends on method: candy 20–220 bags/min, four-sides sealed 50–150 packs/min, heat shrink 20–100 bags/min, three-dimensional 40–80 bags/min, self-adhesive strip 20–80 packs/min, banding 5–20 packs/min.

**How long does a complete card packaging line take to deliver?**
Standard machines 4–6 weeks; complete lines 6–8 weeks; custom-engineered solutions 8–12 weeks. On-site installation and training add 2–4 weeks.

**Can one line handle different card sizes?**
Yes. CHANFER machines handle poker (63×88mm), bridge (56×88mm), mini, tarot and custom sizes, with recipe-based changeover in 3–5 minutes.

**Does CHANFER provide contract packaging, not just machines?**
Yes. A 5,000 m² cleanroom facility runs contract packaging with CHANFER's own equipment, staff and film.
